rule: A type variable resolves to its declared bound (C++: a concept that pins one type, `std::same_as<T>` / `derived_from<T>`; otherwise unconstrained, stays low). | **Body-less member declarations of scanned types are defined in the scan (high)**
source: KNOWN_GAP: generic type parameters are named instead of their single bound (T#m, Backend#now)
notes: Layout: src/ (the scan root) holds a Cargo package, Cargo.toml plus src/*.rs, so module paths are crate-relative. Each type parameter has exactly one bound: inline `T: Clock`, a where-clause `T: Clock`, and the struct/impl parameter `B: Backend` behind the field backend: B. The receiver resolves to the bound → Clock#now / Backend#now, high (body-less trait methods of scanned traits, Decision 2026-11-09). T#now / B#now are wrong. Service<B> drops its generic argument → Service#poll. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (including path calls Type::assoc()) and direct for free functions, module-path functions and named nested functions.
